title: Jia day master – the tall tree
body_md:
Jia is Yang Wood, the image of a great tree growing straight toward the sky. If your day master is Jia, you tend to be upright, ambitious, comfortable at the front and uncomfortable when bent to someone else's will. People around you feel steadied, as if resting in your shade.

The blind spot is stiffness: a tree too rigid snaps. Admitting mistakes and changing course when conditions shift come hard. The classics say Jia needs deep earth to root in and a touch of Metal to prune it into fine timber. This week, invite one blunt piece of feedback on your current work and hear it out fully before answering.
source_ref: Classical Bazi stem imagery (Dích Thiên Tủy / 滴天髓 tradition); editor seed 2026-10

title: Yi day master – the flowering vine
body_md:
Yi is Yin Wood: grasses, flowers and climbing vines, soft but tough, bending in the wind and standing again. If your day master is Yi, you adapt gracefully, communicate with finesse and find your way to the goal by working with circumstances rather than against them. Yi people often have a fine aesthetic sense and surprising stamina.

The blind spot is leaning too long on a support, worrying ahead of time, and talking around a point instead of making it. The classics picture Yi wrapping around Jia to climb high and blooming under Bing sunlight. This week, decide one small matter alone that you would normally run past someone else.
source_ref: Classical Bazi stem imagery (Dích Thiên Tủy / 滴天髓 tradition); editor seed 2026-10
author: human

title: Bing day master – the sun
body_md:
Bing is Yang Fire, the midday sun: it shines on everything and needs nobody to switch it on. If your day master is Bing, you are open, generous, enthusiastic and easily the centre of a room. You illuminate others, hand out energy freely and rarely hold a grudge.

The blind spot is haste, speaking before thinking, and forgetting that not everyone can stand full glare. The classics say Bing does not fear abundant Water because the sun is not put out by rain, but it is easily drawn into entanglements by Xin Metal. This week, let one person finish their whole thought before you add yours.
source_ref: Classical Bazi stem imagery (Dích Thiên Tủy / 滴天髓 tradition); editor seed 2026-10
author: human

title: Ding day master – the lamp flame
body_md:
Ding is Yin Fire: a candle, a hearth, starlight at night, not dazzling but warm and able to light what is near. If your day master is Ding, you are refined, considerate, deep-thinking and good at reading the person in front of you. You are quiet, yet once lit you burn for a long time.

The blind spot is oversensitivity, being wounded by words, and simmering silently instead of speaking. The classics say Ding needs Jia Wood as fuel to burn long and dreads Gui Water, the steady drizzle that drowns a small flame. This week, tell one person plainly what has been bothering you, gently but clearly.

title: Wu day master – the mountain
body_md:
Wu is Yang Earth: a high mountain, a dyke, broad and hard to move. If your day master is Wu, you are dependable, keep your word, forgive easily and are usually the one who shoulders the load when the group hits trouble. You are not loud, yet people lean on you without being asked.

The blind spot is conservatism, slow change and taking on so much that everything jams. The classics say Wu needs Wood to till it alive and Water so it does not dry out; warmed by Bing sunlight it grows everything. This week, hand one task you are holding fully to someone else and do not check each step.
source_ref: Classical Bazi stem imagery (Dích Thiên Tủy / 滴天髓 tradition); editor seed 2026-10

title: Ji day master – the garden soil
body_md:
Ji is Yin Earth: moist, fertile farmland, unshowy yet able to nourish whatever is sown in it. If your day master is Ji, you are attentive, good at caring for people, a natural keeper of things and quietly enduring. You are the kind of person who remembers every small detail about those you love.

The blind spot is worry, self-doubt and holding things inside until the body complains. The classics say Ji Earth loves Bing Fire to warm it and Gui Water to moisten it, and dislikes too much Jia Wood draining the soil. This week, take one worry that keeps circling and write it down so it stops living only in your head.
source_ref: Classical Bazi stem imagery (Dích Thiên Tủy / 滴天髓 tradition); editor seed 2026-10

title: Geng day master – raw metal, the axe
body_md:
Geng is Yang Metal: iron ore, an axe head, an unpolished sword, strong, straight and decisive. If your day master is Geng, you value loyalty, hate beating around the bush, decide quickly and will step forward to protect someone weaker. You carry pressure that others avoid.

The blind spot is bluntness that wounds, stubbornness and a loneliness that comes when nobody dares to challenge you. The classics say Geng Metal needs Ding Fire to forge it into a tool and Ren Water to whet it sharp. This week, deliver one hard truth to someone, opening with "I am saying this because I value you".
source_ref: Classical Bazi stem imagery (Dích Thiên Tủy / 滴天髓 tradition); editor seed 2026-10

title: Xin day master – refined gold, the jewel
body_md:
Xin is Yin Metal: gold, silver, a cut gem already worked, exquisite, bright and valuable in its own right. If your day master is Xin, you are particular, tasteful, self-respecting and alert to beauty and fairness alike. You like finishing things properly and dislike being taken lightly.

The blind spot is perfectionism that wears you down, holding grievances long, and feeling bruised by even small criticism. The classics say Xin Metal loves Ren Water to wash it brilliant and fears Ding Fire scorching the precious piece. This week, ship one piece of work at "good enough" instead of waiting for flawless.
source_ref: Classical Bazi stem imagery (Dích Thiên Tủy / 滴天髓 tradition); editor seed 2026-10

title: Ren day master – the great river
body_md:
Ren is Yang Water: a great river, the open sea, wide, deep and never still. If your day master is Ren, you are intelligent, flexible, far-sighted and unwilling to be boxed in. You suit work that needs strategic thinking, a broad network and the nerve to travel far.

The blind spot is sprawl, difficulty stopping, and sometimes sweeping people along without noticing they are out of their depth. The classics say Ren Water needs Wu Earth as a bank so it does not flood, and Geng Metal as a source so it does not run dry. This week, choose one single goal and follow it to the weekend without opening a new branch.
source_ref: Classical Bazi stem imagery (Dích Thiên Tủy / 滴天髓 tradition); editor seed 2026-10

title: Gui day master – rain, mist, the spring
body_md:
Gui is Yin Water: drizzle, morning mist, an underground spring, quietly seeping into everything. If your day master is Gui, you are sensitive, intuitive, private and highly adaptable. You understand people more through feeling than through words.

The blind spot is vagueness, being carried off by moods, and withdrawing when you feel misunderstood. The classics prize Gui Water when Geng or Xin Metal feeds it as a source and Bing Fire warms it so it can rise as cloud. This week, turn one vague feeling you have into a clear sentence spoken to the person it concerns.
